text: This report provides the Audit Results, as prepared by PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC), to assist the Board in reviewing the financial statements for the year ended December 31, 2018. The Audit Results Report was reviewed and discussed at the Policy and Finance Committee meeting on May 13, 2019, and was received for information.
The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo received for information the audit results report (May 9, 2019) prepared by PricewaterhouseCoopers for the year ended December 31, 2018.
